reference.question:
The legs have lengths 6 and 8. How long is the hypotenuse? (Right triangle; the result is an integer.)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_174_q1_question_en.svg)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Pythagorean theorem

The hypotenuse is \(\sqrt{6^2+8^2}=\sqrt{100}=10\).
